summary: We developed a project that includes map of the Mars where you can experience future landings(as human) alongside with the previous ones(Mars rovers). As well as it is a good map for future landers, it is a trainer for them. Good to mention that our project includes our own AI that use all the data from the past and gives user the correct information on the places he stands on, so it is a revising tool as well.
details: It includes map of the Mars, with the ability to experience future and past landings. Everything is in HTNL. To help creating our code we used two AI's: Google Gemini and Claude. And for design: Chatpgt.
